title: Avi Loeb: Aliens, Black Holes, and the Mystery of the Oumuamua | Lex Fridman Podcast #154
summary: Lex Fridman interviews Harvard astrophysicist Avi Loeb about the interstellar object Oumuamua, aliens and black holes. Loeb lays out his argument that it may be an artifact rather than debris.
why: HN recommends it as a good, non-sensational presentation of Loeb's actual argument, usually linked in Oumuamua threads.

quote.text: There's a good interview with Avi Loeb on the Lex Fridman podcast about this very topic.
